rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for badly damaging or mangling something.

example.english: Be careful, don't mangle the model.
example.traditional: 你小心啲，唔好整爛個模型。
example.jyutping: nei5 siu2 sam1 di1 m4 hou2 zing2 laan6 go3 mou4 jing4

rows.jyutping: zing2 dou2 min6 muk6 cyun4 fei1
rows.note: Use this when the damage disfigures something or someone so badly that it is no longer recognizable.

example.english: They mangle this painting beyond recognition.
example.traditional: 啲人將呢幅畫整到面目全非。
example.jyutping: di1 jan2 zoeng1 ne1 fuk1 waak6 zing2 dou2 min6 muk6 cyun4 fei1

rows.jyutping: zaam2 dou3 cat1 ling4 baat3 lok6
rows.note: Use this specifically when something is mangled by being cut or chopped into scattered pieces.

example.english: They mangle the steak, chopping it into scattered pieces.
example.traditional: 佢亂咁斬塊牛扒，斬到七零八落。
example.jyutping: keoi5 lyun6 gam3 zaam2 faai3 ngau4 paa2 zaam2 dou3 cat1 ling4 baat3 lok6
